title: UK Government cracks down on ‘cosmetic cowboys’ with new rules
summary: A ban on high-risk cosmetics procedures for teens and hefty fines for those who flout the law have been proposed by the UK Government, while only qualified and regulated health care professionals will be able to perform certain cosmetic procedures, such as Liquid Brazilian Butt Lifts (BBLs)

extraction.key_fact: 영국 정부가 청소년 대상 고위험 미용 시술 금지와 시술 자격 제한을 제안했다.
